No, the Earth is not flat. 

**Evidence for a spherical Earth:**

* **Curvature of the Earth:**  We have photos and footage from space clearly showing the Earth's curvature. Satellites and spacecraft orbit the Earth, further confirming its spherical shape. (Source: NASA, [https://www.nasa.gov/](https://www.nasa.gov/))
* **Ships disappearing hull first over the horizon:** As a ship sails away from shore, it gradually disappears hull first, not just getting smaller and smaller. This is because the Earth's curvature blocks the view from our perspective. (Source:  ScienceDirect, [https://www.sciencedirect.com/](https://www.sciencedirect.com/))
* **Lunar eclipses:**  The Earth casts a round shadow on the Moon during a lunar eclipse. (Source: NASA, [https://www.nasa.gov/](https://www.nasa.gov/))
* **Circumnavigation:**  People have circumnavigated the globe, traveling in a single direction and returning to their starting point. (Source:  National Geographic, [https://www.nationalgeographic.com/](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/))
* **Gravity:**  The Earth's gravitational pull is consistent across the globe. If the Earth were flat, gravity would pull objects towards the center of the flat plane, resulting in uneven distribution. (Source:  NASA, [https://www.nasa.gov/](https://www.nasa.gov/))


The idea of a flat Earth has been debunked numerous times by scientific evidence and observations.
